meta.title: 6 signs you're an overthinker (and how to stop)

beats.text: Six signs you're an overthinker — and one way out.
One. You replay old conversations for hours, editing what you should have said.
Two. You read meaning into every text, pause, and change of tone.
Three. You rehearse disasters in detail that almost never actually happen.
Four. You agonise over a decision — then doubt it the moment it's made.
Five. Rest feels like guilt, because your mind refuses to clock off.
Six. You need total certainty before you'll take even a small step.
The way out: name the worry, give it a five-minute window, then take one small action. Action quiets the spiral.
